summary: Inspected all 33 changed/added files in books/kestrel/@subtrees/1. All files are Kestrel Institute ACL2 books containing genuine formal mathematics: treemap/internal (15 files for delete, lookup, restrict, rotate, split, tree, update, update-star), treeset/internal (16 files for delete, diff, in, insert, intersect, rotate, split, tree, union), utilities/fixed-size-words/fixnum.lisp, utilities/top.lisp, utilities/total-order/compare-defs.lisp, utilities/total-order/compare.lisp, and utilities/bit-vectors/bitops.lisp. Every file contains define forms with guards and type prescriptions, defrule/defruled theorems with inductive proofs, xdoc documentation, MBE logic/exec definitions, congruence rules, linear arithmetic rules, and forward-chaining rules. None are build artifacts (like the previously excluded .sys/*@useless-runes.lsp files), certification/customization/portcullis wrappers, or declaration-free files. All contain unique searchable formal mathematical content.
